one_liner: Senior HUD IT-office role improving how HUD's contact centers serve the public: analyzing call/chat data, writing knowledge-management rules and SOPs, and pushing fixes with leadership.
fit_summary: GS-13 needs a year at GS-12 level in contact center performance analysis and customer experience strategy. Daniel's closest experience is leading the five-person ReBuild NC intake center for homeowners (2019) and answering employee questions at IEM, which falls well short of contact-center analytics, so it's a reach.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens/nationals); a separate announcement ST-13053562-26-CF covers status candidates, so Daniel applies under this public one.

One year (52 weeks) of specialized experience equivalent to GS-12 covering all three areas: contact center data analysis, CX/knowledge management governance or SOPs across multiple channels, and cross-functional collaboration on customer service improvement.
Public Trust background investigation and suitability (Declaration for Federal Employment); no security clearance required.
No degree substitution is listed for GS-13, so qualification rests entirely on documented experience.
keywords: voice, email, chat, messaging, and in-person channels
strategy: If he applies, lead with the ReBuild NC intake center, but treat this as a reach and prioritize GS-9 to GS-11 or state and local constituent-services roles.

Map each of the three 'AND' specialized-experience elements to a specific bullet on his two-page resume, written in his own words with the posting's key terms, and include month/day/year dates and hours per week.

Frame his IEM work as service to the public and to government clients: leading the five-person ReBuild NC intake center that answered homeowners' questions (2019) and organizing FEMA Public Assistance onboarding data for decision makers. Claim surge communications, survivor outreach or SOP writing only if he did them.

Prepare for the online competency assessment (reasoning, reading comprehension, interpersonal skills, etc.) by taking it in a quiet setting in one sitting. Answer truthfully, since overstating can remove you.
Apply between Oct 20 and Nov 2, 2026, and submit early. The window is only two weeks and the resume must stay within two pages.
resume_bullets: Led a five-person intake center for ReBuild NC after Hurricane Matthew, answering homeowners' questions about recovery program applications (2019).
Answered employee travel-expense questions in Certify and handled first-line IT troubleshooting with IT support (2019–2024).
Helped sequence onboarding for FEMA Public Assistance employees by organizing spreadsheets and analyzing the data for decision makers (2019–2020).
interview_questions: Tell us about a time you used contact center or service data to recommend a change leadership adopted.
How would you build knowledge management governance so agents give consistent answers across phone, chat, and email?
Describe how you negotiated with resistant stakeholders to implement a cross-cutting process improvement.
What CX metrics would you track for a federal contact center, and why?
watch_outs: The specialized experience is narrow and stacked with 'AND' requirements, so without real contact center/CX work Daniel will likely be rated not qualified.
Duty station is assigned from listed locations and the role is not remote. Confirm a DC-area site is available before accepting.
The application window is short (closes Nov 2, 2026), and the posting may cap applications.
